note: Enumerated P2 set (§45). A P2 may remain only if explicitly classified and proven NOT to hide an intended-capability failure, a security/privacy failure, a safety failure, or P0/P1 severity. OPEN_P0=0, OPEN_P1=0 (from RELEASE_LOCK + acceptance).

p2.description: The current Certification Capsule was sealed from a working tree with pre-existing dirty harness files (WORKTREE_HARNESS_CLEAN=false) — it is a CHECKPOINT capsule, not a FINAL clean-isolated one.
p2.whyP2NotP0P1: Product evidence (PREVIEW-class RC acceptance) is independent of harness-tree cleanliness; the capsule honestly records the flag. No product capability is affected.
p2.releaseRelevance: blocks FINAL_RELEASE_CERTIFICATION_CAPSULE, not the product verdict
p2.disposition: close by re-sealing from a clean isolated worktree/checkout (obligation final-release-capsule)

p2.description: RUNTIME_SOURCE_SHA provenance is PROVEN_BY_VERSION_BINDING (buildVersion↔commit), not artifact-native (no build-injected commit SHA in /api/health).
p2.whyP2NotP0P1: The binding is authoritative for the current RC (deployed buildVersion maps to a unique commit with zero runtime drift). Artifact-native SHA is a strengthening, not a correctness fix.
p2.releaseRelevance: productize build-injected SHA into the NEXT materialization/Production path
p2.disposition: add a build-injected commit SHA to /api/health in the next runtime build

p2.description: Rate limiting is instance-local (per serverless instance) only; a distributed cross-instance limit is not provisioned.
p2.whyP2NotP0P1: Per-request caps + per-IP sliding window + per-instance cost circuit breaker are shipped and reduce single-source amplification; the residual (a distributed flood across instances) is bounded per-instance and labelled precisely, not overstated as global.
p2.disposition: OWNER: provision shared KV if abuse is observed
